name: Emperor Palpatine
bannerMiniatureIdeas: Emperor's throne dais with crimson cushions, twisted cane, and crackling Force lightning arcs
Death Star II hologram pedestal ringed by crossed Royal Guard force pikes
Senate chamber podium fragment with Imperial crest and a miniature crumpled Jedi cloak
vehicleSuggestions: Death Star II (throne room command fortress)

factionTrait.name: Marauders Champion
factionTrait.text: A marauder moves the turn token +1 step when they knock out an enemy follower.

uniqueTraits.name: Unlimited Power Surge
uniqueTraits.text: When Emperor Palpatine makes an advance action, he may gain +1 {speed} for that action. If he does, he must move in a straight line.

ultimate.name: Unlimited Power
ultimate.text: Move Emperor Palpatine up to 2 hexes. Then make a 3 {damage_die} damage roll against each enemy within range.

plotSkills.name: Force Lightning
plotSkills.text: If Emperor Palpatine moved 3 or more hexes this activation, Force Lightning is a bonus action. Hit Effect: Inflict {dodge_blight}.

clashSkills.name: Wrath of the Emperor
clashSkills.text: If Emperor Palpatine moved 3 or more hexes this activation, Wrath of the Emperor is a bonus action.

clashSkills.name: Chain Lightning
clashSkills.text: Hit Effect: After the Chain Lightning damage roll, Emperor Palpatine may make a 3 {damage_die} damage roll against up to 2 other models within 1 hex of the target's hex.

traits.name: Eternal Vigil
traits.text: At the end of the Royal Guards' activation, if any Royal Guards are adjacent to Emperor Palpatine, Emperor Palpatine gains {protection_boon}.

plotSkills.name: Form Ranks
plotSkills.text: Move each Royal Guard up to 1 hex.

clashSkills.name: Form Ranks
clashSkills.text: Move each Royal Guard up to 1 hex.
